He has provided a very direct answer to this part of your question: basically, he says that 'those of us that are alive today cannot concern ourselves with what other humans will do in the future, 500 or 1000 years from now; we can only deal with the present situation as it is.'

This is a paraphrase of a portion of 'Industrial Society and Its Future'. If you want to read this thought in its original form, look to paragraph 212 of ISAIF.
